title: artemisia ludoviciana var. pabularis
intro: Artemisia ludoviciana var. pabularis, commonly known as Louisiana sagewort or white sage, is a perennial herb native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing, sore throat, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Louisiana sagewort include expectorant and anti-tussive effects, helping to relieve respiratory issues and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
